library.qualificationNote: Only the selected regression tests changed between these digests; no previous platform qualification is transferred.

method: A temporary hidden Catch test used a derived filter with explicit raw capture to import the local ezdxf R2010 source. For this diagnostic only, the test set each stored raw-only marker false to bypass the committed export guard; no production code or source drawing was modified. The diagnostic test was removed afterward and the consumer checkout was clean. The output files were scratch-only.

source.provenance: Locally generated from scratch using ezdxf 1.4.5 new(R2010, setup=True), with a named linetype and line; see p8d-librecad-native-ltype-isolated-2026-11-25.json.

positive.observation: Same-version unguarded filter export succeeded. Independent ezdxf 1.4.4 readback resolved ACAD_MATERIAL E, ByBlock 95, ByLayer 96, Global 97, each material owner/reactor E and CMATERIAL 96; the LINE retained its endpoints and P8D_CUSTOM. Audit returned zero errors and repairs, and ordered tag comparison found all 61 material groups preserved except intended self-handle remapping. A later physical-tag inspection found that all three source LAYER group-347 values were missing from the output. ezdxf supplied default material links in memory, so those links do not prove physical preservation.

negative.mutation: In a fresh import, bypass the raw-only markers as above and remove only the retained Global raw MATERIAL carrier; keep its typed metadata, dictionary and layer references.
negative.observation: The unguarded exporter returned success and emitted Global as an 8-group typed MATERIAL instead of the original 61 groups. The dictionary and target handles resolved and ezdxf audit still returned zero errors and zero repairs. A later physical-tag inspection also found no LAYER group-347 values. Structural audit alone cannot establish material payload or layer-reference preservation; missing raw capture must prevent typed fallback and refuse atomically.

limits: Both results deliberately bypass the production guard and are not supported workflow results. Production opt-in remains disabled and the guard was not modified.

Only one locally generated source, one macOS headless filter configuration, one ASCII same-version target and a selected missing-carrier mutation were observed. No edited-source, Binary DXF, DWG conversion, native material rendering or general graph semantics are established.
Complete graph and payload admission, output readback, refusal/retry, edit invalidation and native platform qualification remain open.

guardRegression.coverage: The opted-in filter imports a locally generated AC1021 raw-only material. The production exporter preserves the destination and refuses before and after its retained raw carrier is removed; a subsequent complete-material save succeeds on the same filter.
guardRegression.result: Focused system-codec test passed: 18 assertions in 1 case. dyld verified the isolated current implementation library. The test deliberately removes the carrier in memory; it never disables the production guard.

physicalLayerCorrection.wireObservation: Source layers 0, Defpoints and P8D_LAYER each contain physical group 347 value 21. The old positive output contains no group 347 in any of the three layer records; ezdxf defaulted those in memory. The source CMATERIAL 20 and output CMATERIAL 96 are physically present.
physicalLayerCorrection.supersededClaim: The earlier statement that ezdxf layer links proved source layer-reference preservation was incorrect.
